location.story: Prince Wicked And The Grateful Animals

approved_translation: Kindness to animals is rewarded; cruelty brings its own punishment.
translation_author: Ellen C. Babbitt (retold from traditional sources)
context_summary: Once upon a time a king had a son named Prince Wicked. He was fierce and cruel, and he spoke to nobody without abuse, or blows. He had a glass box made for the Rat's home, and a cage of gold for the Parrot. Each had the food he liked best of all to eat every day, and so these four lived happily all their lives.
